$comment: Regression expectations for scripts/stitch-eval.mjs. Every number here was MEASURED
on 2026-09-04 — they are the floor the engine must not fall below, not aspirations.
The PDFs are local (~ expands to $HOME) and are deliberately not in the repo, so this
suite is not part of `npm test`.
minAligned    the fewest units the run may place (recall floor)
maxAligned    the most it may place — for a NEGATIVE set, where any placement is a
false pair between sheets that do not share ground
verdictFloor  the weakest honesty verdict accepted: verified > partial > unverified
maxWorstResidFt  the worst CROSS-seam disagreement, in feet, between a seam's own
measurement and the solved layout (see stitchCore's worstResidFt)
maxSuspectSeams  seams the post-solve verification positively believes are wrong
groundTruth   a hand-verified placement fixture; the runner reports per-unit error
maxTileErrorFt   the bar for a unit the solver CLAIMS (along-anchored, i.e. offered
as aligned). A unit that is not along-anchored is demoted to unaligned
by the commit, so its error is reported, never failed — but it must
never be claimed. This is the 'offered means it works' invariant.

sets.name: PG_SITE 1A
sets.notes: The reference set. 11 plan units (p2's two strips + p3-p11) are PLACED, but none is along-anchored: the only seams that fix the along axis form a component the solve root is not in, and the sibling-strip seam does not anchor. Measured ground-truth errors run 0-52 ft (p8 42, p11 52, strips 24/17), so claiming any of them would break 'offered means it works'. Ground truth: scripts/fixtures/pg-site-1a.groundtruth.json, which now DECLARES its origin convention (page origins, strips keyed 1s1/1s2) — the runner converts each pose's frame origin before comparing.

sets.name: Belcourt Grading Plans
sets.notes: Four tiled sheets printed 5-8, all text outlined, so identity and callouts are OCR-only. Aligned 0/4 before T0. Verdict is honestly `unverified` (the along-matchline axis is unproven on two of three seams), so no floor is set.

sets.name: El Centro (negative set)
sets.pdf: ~/Downloads/CA240435 - EL CENTRO_GRADING_REV 1 CHANGES PRIOR TO REV 2 (FOR BIDDING PURPOSES).pdf
sets.notes: Notes, details and single plans that share no ground. NOTHING may be placed: any placement here is a false pair. Produced 3 before T0.

sets.name: Coast Guard pair (CD102-CD103)
sets.notes: Two 36x24 CAD sheets, 1"=30', all callouts OUTLINED (0 text-channel matchline hits on either page) so identity and adjacency are OCR-only. It CANNOT be aligned from the signals present and must not be forced: CD103 never references CD102 (its callouts name CD101 and CD104), so the only link is one-directional CD102 -> CD103, and OCR returns that target as the truncated "HEET CD1". Both pages' matchlines land on the SAME (left) edge, so no facing pair exists either. What IS asserted: both pages carry a detected edge ref (so the app says "these sheets don't share a matchline", not "no callouts were found"), and no false pair is invented. If a future OCR change makes this pair align, verify the placement by eye and RAISE maxAligned.
